name: The Da Vinci Code
overview: The Scriptures warn against seeking counsel apart from the Lord, as seen in Isaiah 30:1 where rebellion leads to sin. The coming of Christ, foretold in Micah 5:2 from Bethlehem, affirms God's eternal plan. The betrayal of Jesus for thirty pieces of silver, referenced in Zechariah 11:12, and His resurrection witnessed by Mary Magdalene (Mark 16:1,9) emphasize the truth of the gospel. These verses call believers to trust in God's revealed Word rather than human speculation or secret traditions.
